scope.lenders: German credit institutions (including Sparkassen, Landesbanken and development banks) granting consumer credit
scope.note: An operational baseline, not an exhaustive legal inventory: real-estate consumer loans, overdrafts and business lending are out of scope.

rules.title: Creditworthiness assessment before the contract
rules.citation: BGB § 505a Abs. 1; for credit institutions also KWG § 18a Abs. 1
rules.requirement_summary: Assess the borrower's creditworthiness before concluding a consumer loan; for a general consumer loan conclude it only if the assessment raises no significant doubt that the borrower will meet the contractual obligations.

evidence_requirements.description: Completed assessment, dated before the contract
Rationale tying the decision to the assessed facts

rules.title: Information the assessment rests on
rules.requirement_summary: For a general consumer loan, base the assessment on information from the borrower and, where necessary, from credit reference agencies allowed to supply data for assessing consumers' creditworthiness.

evidence_requirements.description: Sources used: borrower's information and any credit reference agency
How the information was checked, including contradictions

rules.title: Admissible use of scores
rules.requirement_summary: Use a probability score for a contract decision only if data protection law is met, the data are shown to be significant for the prediction by a scientifically recognised mathematical-statistical method, the score does not rest on address data alone, and, where address data are used, the person was informed beforehand and this is documented.

evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that the scoring method is scientifically recognised and its data significant
Data used for the score, showing it does not rest on address data alone
Documented notice to the person where address data are used

rules.title: Telling the borrower about a refusal
rules.transition_note: From 20 November 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 139, Art. 16). Tracked as a non-blocking transition rule until then; compliance should approve a ruleset version that makes it required from that date.
rules.requirement_summary: If the lender decides not to conclude the contract, tell the borrower without delay and, for a general consumer loan, where appropriate refer them to easily accessible debt advice services.

evidence_requirements.description: Notice of refusal sent without delay
Referral to debt advice services, where appropriate

rules.title: Relevant and accurate information; no special categories
rules.transition_note: From 20 November 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 139, Art. 16). Tracked as a non-blocking transition rule until then; compliance should approve a ruleset version that makes it required from that date.
rules.requirement_summary: Base the assessment on relevant and accurate information on income, expenses and other financial and economic circumstances that is necessary and proportionate; for general consumer loans it must not include special categories of personal data under Art. 9(1) GDPR.

evidence_requirements.description: Information used and why it is necessary and proportionate
Evidence that Art. 9(1) GDPR data are not used

rules.title: Human intervention in an automated assessment
rules.transition_note: From 20 November 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 139, Art. 16). Tracked as a non-blocking transition rule until then; compliance should approve a ruleset version that makes it required from that date.
rules.requirement_summary: Where the assessment for a general consumer loan involves automated processing of personal data, the borrower can require the intervention of a person: a clear and comprehensible explanation of the assessment (including the logic and risks of the automated processing and its significance for the decision), the chance to state their own view, and a review of the assessment and the decision. The lender must inform the borrower of these rights once the automated processing is complete.

evidence_requirements.description: How a borrower obtains review by a person
The explanation given: logic, risks, significance for the decision
Notice of these rights after the automated processing

rules.title: Refusal based on a credit database or automated processing
rules.transition_note: From 20 November 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 139, Art. 16). Tracked as a non-blocking transition rule until then; compliance should approve a ruleset version that makes it required from that date.
rules.requirement_summary: A lender that refuses a consumer loan because of a credit reference agency's information must tell the consumer without delay, with the information received, the database consulted and the data categories considered; where the assessment rests on automated processing, it must also tell the borrower that fact, the right to review by a person and how to contest the refusal.

evidence_requirements.description: Notice of refusal
Information received, database consulted, data categories
How to obtain review by a person and contest the refusal

rules.title: Scoring: data that may not be used, disclosure and challenge
rules.transition_note: From 20 November 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 139, Art. 16). Tracked as a non-blocking transition rule until then; compliance should approve a ruleset version that makes it required from that date.
rules.requirement_summary: A score may be created or used only if it does not use special categories of data, age, gender, name, social-network data, payment flows on bank accounts or address data, does not concern a minor, and rests on data shown to be significant by a scientifically recognised method; on request the person is told the data and criteria used, their weighting and the score's meaning, and may contest the decision, state their view and obtain a decision by a natural person.

evidence_requirements.description: Features used, showing none of the excluded data
Scientifically recognised method; significance of the data
How data, criteria, weighting and meaning are disclosed on request
How the person contests and obtains a decision by a natural person
